title: Bills execs push back on negative narratives around new $2.2 billion stadium

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bills execs push back on negative narratives around new $2.2 billion stadium
sources.description: Bills’ executives pushed back on the negative narratives surrounding the new $2.2 billion Highmark Stadium after fans voiced their complaints on social media about obstructed-view seats to the size of the scoreboard at the new Western New York venue.
